name: Hackaton 2026
description: Join the hackaton, find your challenge, and share findings with verified Möbius participants.

store.tagline: Build together. Share discoveries. Celebrate ideas.
store.description:
Hackaton 2026 brings a science-festival feel to a collaborative hackathon. Join the event, explore challenge briefs, and share findings, links, images and replies with verified Möbius participants. The Rewards page has mystery top-three podiums for Best Apps, Best Games, Bug Fixes and Best Memes.

Early event release: challenge briefs and rules are placeholders and will be updated later. Rewards remain To Be Announced; this release does not score entries or reveal winners.

Requires an online Möbius installation and a connected Möbius identity. Install the app in your own Möbius to connect to the shared Hackaton event automatically. Previously saved alternate hosts are preserved and clearly marked; choose Use shared event to switch. Comments and counts refresh automatically while the view is open. Findings and participant lists are available to members of each challenge.
